title: NFR-005 Explainability: qualification decisions persist reason plus evidence
risk: A qualification score or routing decision cannot be explained afterwards, so neither the sales team nor an auditor can justify why a customer was treated a certain way.
preconditions: Namespace gov-nfr-<case_id>-<worker_id>; NFR verification runs against the offline gateway with mock SoR and channel boundaries.
Frozen clock 2026-01-15T10:00:00Z; failure, outage and crash injections are scripted at the substituted boundary, never faked inside the assertion.

steps.action: Run the qualification and recommendation decision for cust-a
steps.expected: A decision record is produced with a numeric score and a status.
The record contains a human-readable reason, at least one evidence reference, the inputs used and the agent identity.
Each reference resolves to a real record (for example ORD-A-1) and its timestamp precedes the decision timestamp.

steps.action: Inspect the audit row for the same run
steps.expected: The audit row decision field carries the reasoning summary and confidence consistent with the decision record.

assertions: Every persisted decision has a non-empty reason and at least one resolvable evidence reference.
Evidence timestamps precede the decision, so the reason cannot cite the future.
The score in the decision record matches the score in the audit row; the two surfaces do not disagree.
The decision is reproducible from its recorded inputs and rule version.
forbidden: Storing a reason string that is the model's own prose with no evidence reference.
Citing an evidence id that does not resolve.
Recording different scores on the decision and audit surfaces.
evidence: Decision record and audit row for the run.
Rule version and input snapshot used for reproducibility.
cleanup: Delete gov- decision rows after export; customer context cache entries are cleared.
automation: Core PEP, rules engine, audit writer, idempotency store and worker lease logic run as real code under test; only ERP/WMS, channel gateways, Redis and the model provider are substituted. Faults are injected at those boundaries and waits are condition-based on persisted state.
note: Generated acceptance specification. Plain specification, not an executable test; no application runtime exists, so the status is NOT_RUN.
